spec.name: Earnings drift v24
spec.notes: Rank names by the latest earnings surprise and hold through the drift.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.5, annual return 8%, maximum drawdown 3%.

exhibits.summary: On the sealed period (strict mode, 10 bps) the Sharpe ratio is 2.36 against 2.52 in research, a gap of +0.16.
The log holds 2 distinct specs; the best of 2 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.00, so the claimed 2.50 becomes 2.50 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 2.33 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean -0.01, 95th percentile 0.41).
The signal has no numeric windows or parameters to perturb.
The scan (a heuristic) found no phrase addressed to reviewers or giving instructions in 2 text sources.
